subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Where Argus drives a GitHub feature draft and has the mainline approve-merge grant, the Argus workflow shall inspect the prepared contract, verify both independent current-digest reviews and required native checks, submit its exact-head approval through FR-59, and record the host review identity and policy commit before advancing. Without grant it shall request the operator; explicit local-git retains operator approval and landing.
rationale: Approval is a driver judgment after independent review, not an automatic consequence of green checks
fit_criterion: The granted drive submits a typed decision with current review references; ungranted and local drives request the operator; changed contract content requires both independent reviews again and a fresh approval.
